messages:
incident-bot: PAGED #eng-oncall - cont-batch path p99 spike in us-east-1. p99=2200ms, p95=540ms, affected streaming/generation routes. Pager: @oncall-alice. Incident ID: INC-2026-1842
oncall-alice: looking. quick check: any 5xxs? :eyes:
sre-ben: seeing tail increase on streaming RT routes. traces show long queue wait times in packer. KV eviction spikes ~2m ago.
runtime-sam: tagging nodes: packer-std-7 shows high pack_latency_ms distribution. running continuous-batcher v1.12.3
ml-ryan: workload note: a customer is sending many long sequences (tokens > 1024) with streaming enabled — mixed with short ones, causing packer padding amplification.
oncall-alice: ops runbook step1: reduce packer max_wait to 12ms. pushing quick config:
```bash
curl -XPOST http://packer-ctrl/set \n -d '{"PACKER_MAX_WAIT_MS":12,"MAX_BATCH_TOKENS":8192}'
```
sre-ben: applied to canary (us-east-1a). p99 in canary down to ~980ms. good sign.
runtime-sam: also lowering max_batch_size for streaming consumers to 8 to avoid padding amplification.
ml-ryan: suggest enabling seq-hash bucketing: split flows by seq_len buckets (<=128,129-512,>512) for fair packing. quick patch ready: PR#4234
oncall-alice: rolling patch to packer config across cluster; also temporarily reduce KV cache TTL to 30s to avoid eviction storms: `KV_CACHE_TTL=30s`
pm-carla: any customer impact? which tenants are seeing this?
sre-ben: only 2 tenants crossing p99 (acme-inc, devchat). both low-volume, no 5xxs, but some user-facing latency for streaming sessions. recommend notifying acme-support.
oncall-alice: drafting incident note, pinging CSM @carla to notify. :pencil2: 
ops-bot: deploy status: rollout canary ok, 3/10 hosts updated, no errors.
oncall-alice: if canary looks stable we'll continue rolling. also plan: decrease streaming prefetch window and enable lighter packing for >512 token flows.
oncall-alice: hands off to @oncall-bob for overnight. Bob: see incident INC-2026-1842, PR#4234, and runbook section "packers > mixed-seq len mitigation". escalate to platform if p99 > 2.5s again.
oncall-bob: taking it. monitoring alerts and traces, will finalize postmortem tomorrow morning.
oncall-alice: closing pager for now; marking as mitigation in progress. if anything spikes, page again. :white_check_mark:
